SELECT i.*, u.nickname, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITINERARY_LIKE l WHERE l.itinerary_id = i.itinerary_id ) AS like_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITINERARY_COMMENT c WHERE c.itinerary_id = i.itinerary_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS comment_count,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_ITINERARY_BOOKMARK b WHERE b.itinerary_id = i.itinerary_id AND b.user_id = #{loginUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} ) AS bookmarked
FROM TB_ITINERARY i
JOIN TB_USER u ON u.user_id = i.user_id
WHERE i.status = 'ACTIVE' AND i.visibility = 'PUBLIC'
ORDER BY i.created_at DESC, i.itinerary_id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
